name: vivarium-ai-tools
description: Marketplace for the IHME ai-tools plugins: viv-public (generic developer workflows for any IHME team) and viv (SimSci/vivarium-specific workflows).

plugins.name: viv-public
plugins.description: Generic AI developer workflows for any IHME team, any repo: multi-agent code review, git rescue, commit splitting, type hinting, regression debugging, change propagation, workflow assessment, and a guided TDD loop.

plugins.name: viv
plugins.description: SimSci/vivarium-specific workflows (model development, team conventions, vivarium references). Depends on viv-public — installing viv brings in both.
